rule.statement: A plan already identifying the land in dispute is sufficient for a rei vindicatio action, and there is no necessity to obtain a commission to superimpose that plan on a new plan unless there is a genuine dispute as to the identity of the corpus.
rule.supporting_quote: Where a plan already exists identifying the land in dispute, there is no necessity to obtain a commission to superimpose that plan on a new plan unless there is a genuine dispute as to the identity of the corpus.
